messages:
maria: Heads-up — new customer BlueHarbor completed self-serve onboarding but their SDK calls are getting 403s. Console shows an API key under the project, but calls fail with 'project_inactive'. Anyone seen this pattern?

devin: can you paste the exact error payload and project id?

maria: project: bh-78-prod. Error from node SDK: 
```json
{
  "status":403,
  "error":"permission_denied",
  "message":"project_inactive: api key not authorized for active project"
}
```

maria: link to console (redacted): https://console.redwood.ai/projects/bh-78-prod/keys (key visible in UI) :confused: 

alex_p: interesting — sometimes keys surface in the UI when the tenant was auto-migrated from a partner org but the claim binding landed on the old org id. UI lists the key but the runtime routing rejects because project_id != active tenant.

devin: can you repro with curl and include the x-request-id from the runtime? that will help infra trace.

maria: curl output: 
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/completions 
 -H "Authorization: Bearer rkey_live_XXXXX" 
 -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
 -d '{"model":"gpt-small","input":"hi"}' -i
```
response headers include: 
```
HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
x-request-id: rq_0a4b3c9d
content-type: application/json
```

maria: body same as earlier JSON.

sre-bot: @infra-oncall triggered a provisioning trace for rq_0a4b3c9d, ingestion logs forwarded.

infra-oncall: got it, pulling claim bindings and role sync status for bh-78-prod. can you confirm whether this org recently had a partner migration?

maria: customer signed up yesterday via partner flow, yes.

alex_p: likely root cause: claim record for the API key points to partner_org:pt-42 instead of bh-78-prod due to a race in the migration sync. The key shows in console because the UI reads from the keys table which was migrated, but the routing layer uses the live claim binding table which didn't update.

devin: steps to mitigate quickly:
1) create a temporary scoped key in the customer tenant from the console and give the customer that while we fix binding.
2) infra runs one-off DB update to rebind claim for rkey id -> project bh-78-prod and trigger role-sync job.
3) confirm with curl and x-request-id.

infra-oncall: will run the rebind after approvals. need requestor email and ticket id.

maria: filing a ticket now: INC-76821. customer contact: ops+blueharbor@blueharbor.co. Please add a short notice for the customer: "We created a temporary key while we repair your migration binding."

support-bot: created incident INC-76821 and assigned to infra-oncall. ETA for rebind: 30m. :white_check_mark:

alex_p: longer-term action: add a sanity-check in migration pipeline to ensure claim binding updated atomically or add a post-migration reconciliation job. I'll open a PR for the reconciliation job and a test case for partner->org migration.

devin: thanks — once infra confirms, i'll validate end-to-end and then rotate keys with customer.

maria: infra confirmed rebind done. rq_0a4b3c9d now resolves to bh-78-prod in routing logs. customer validated in prod, calls succeeding. closing loop with them now. :tada:
